summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, attaching three news releases dated July 20, 23, and 27, 2026. The filings detail an updated NI 43-101 technical report for the San Francisco Project (no changes to mineral resource estimates) and a corporate update following a prior merger with Gold Resource Corporation, focusing on exploration drilling and mine development. No transaction-specific terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations are present. The filing is a routine business update by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event.
